options.text: The rental income forgone by not leasing the warehouse
The historical purchase price of the warehouse
options.misconception: Treats a sunk cost as an opportunity cost

options.text: The sum of all future profits from the product line
options.misconception: Mistakes total projected benefit for the next-best alternative

options.text: The accounting depreciation recorded on the warehouse
options.misconception: Confuses a non-cash charge with a forgone alternative

questions.explanation: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative given up, here the lease income foregone. Depreciation and historical purchase prices are accounting or sunk costs, and total projected profits are not the forgone alternative.
questions.hint: Opportunity cost is what you give up, not what you spent.
